history.overview: The Outer Ring is the fortified perimeter of the Sanctum, where Riftseekers repel Muramite intrusions and contain planar leaks.

timeline.name: Outer Ring Constructed
timeline.description: Riftseekers built the ring to protect the Sanctum’s inner chambers.

timeline.name: Containment Pylons Installed
timeline.description: Pylons were added to stabilize planar leaks from the Rift Heart.

timeline.name: Muramite Occupation
timeline.description: Muramite forces established a foothold on the outer walkways.

timeline.name: Discord Breaches
timeline.description: Discord manifestations began erupting from containment failures.
